Delivery executes in `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go`; `PostAsync` queues to workers that call it. `safeDialContext` in that same file blocks dialing to reserved or private IPs at connection time. `ValidateURL` in `internal/webhook/validate.go` rejects webhook URLs that resolve to private IPs via `isReservedIP` and `reservedCIDRs`.

Outbound webhook HTTP POSTs run in `Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`), which is what the async workers call.
